name: Chicken Nugget
description_html: Chicken Nugget is in need of a life reset. She was tied up and left abandoned at the gates of the. shelter. Of course that was pretty scary for her. Thankfully a staff member eventually saw her and buttered her up with some chicken and ever since then she's knows she's in a place of kindness. This is how she earned her namesake. When she was checked over, there were some hints of weather exposure seen, poor girl. It's time for Chicken Nugget to come inside and be part of a loving family. We can't wait to match her with her lucky people. Will that be you? Come meet her in person.

name: Oreo
description_html:
Meet Oreo! 🖤🤍


Oreo already knows exactly how to be a wonderful companion. This sweet girl is mellow, calm, and affectionate—and she absolutely loves being petted and curling up in your lap.


Whether you’re a first-time cat owner or a lifelong cat lover, Oreo would make an easygoing, loving addition to your home. At 17+ pounds, she’s a big girl with an even bigger heart! ❤️


Oreo would love a family who will help her on her healthy weight-loss journey with plenty of love, encouragement, and appropriate exercise. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate companion who will happily keep you company, Oreo may be your girl.

Sweet, speckled Suki is everything a young puppy should be: Joyful, energetic, curious, and bursting with love!

Suki just joined her foster mom’s pack and is reported to be a sensitive girl who is settling in wonderfully to her new environment.

Suki LOVES the other resident dogs and is great at reading their social cues. She would do wonderfully living with one or more canine companion(s) to show her the ropes and help build her confidence.

She has kisses for everyone and has immediately bonded to the 4-year-old child in her home, showcasing her potential to be an amazing family dog!

This smart cookie is doing great with her potty and crate training, is learning sit, and has mastered using the doggie screen to let herself out into the yard. A curious opportunist (like any young pup), she loves to explore and to chew, so an active household committed to providing enrichment and perfecting her puppy manners would be ideal. 

To top is off, Suki is simply adorable with her speckled, glossy coat and floppy ears. This petite lady is believed to be a kelpie/border collie mix who will be a medium -sized bundle of sunshine when fully grown.

Suki’s smaller size and her loving, eager nature make her a great fit for many different home dynamics—from apartment living to larger country sprawls.

One thing is certain—sweet, smart puppies like her do not stay in the shelter system for long. So inquire today to make Suki part of your family!

name: Lemon Bar
description_html: Lemon Bar came in from an area where residents were doing their best to care for the community cats, however the location became unsafe for them. He's still learning to trust people at the shelter, but he was friendly with his caregivers and we think with a little time, he will come around with us and his new adopters. Lemon Bar would make a great best friend to a cat in the home and can learn social skills by watching other cats engage with people. He has joined his shy cat friends in our Cactus Cats program to help him learn confidence boosting skills that lead to loving and lasting relationships with their human family members. Lemon Bar may take time getting used to new spaces, but with some time and patience we think he will make a loyal cat companion in a home.

name: Dorian
description_html:
Meet Dorian 💛


Dorian may have arrived as a stray, but one thing is already clear: this girl loves people. 🐾


The person who found her said Dorian was surprisingly easy to trap because she was so friendly. At intake, she happily accepted pets and was easy for staff to handle and transfer.


Shelter life has her feeling a little shy in her kennel, but when she gets some one-on-one attention, her affectionate side comes out. She clearly wants interaction and connection—even if she sometimes lets out a little growl during it. We’re still figuring out what she’s trying to communicate, and she deserves someone patient enough to give her the time and space to show us.


Could you be the patient person who helps Dorian feel safe enough to let her personality shine?

name: Swaker
description_html:
Meet Swaker, a Big Softie in the Making 💙


Seven-year-old Swaker clearly knew the comforts of home before he found himself at the shelter. He was already neutered and microchipped—and at more than 13 pounds, he’s definitely a boy with a generous body condition! 😸


Swaker arrived with a recent wound, which our team clipped and cleaned. But what really breaks our hearts is how terrified he was when he first arrived. The good news? He’s slowly coming out of his shell.


We don’t know what Swaker has been through, but we do know that this handsome senior boy deserves to feel safe again. With patience, kindness, and a quiet place to decompress, we’re hoping he can rediscover the confidence of the beloved pet he once was.


If you have room in your heart for a big, seven-year-old boy who needs someone to believe in him, please consider Swaker. ❤️

name: Alakazam
description_html:
Alakazam Needs a Little Magic ✨💙


Poor Alakazam is having a really hard time in the shelter. He was surrendered along with two other cats after his owner began traveling and could no longer care for them, and now this big boy is understandably scared. Just look into those huge, worried eyes. 💔


Despite being terrified, Alakazam did his very best to be a good patient during intake. And that tells us something important: there’s a friendly, gentle cat hiding underneath all that fear.


Alakazam is a big boy who could probably benefit from losing a little weight, but the shelter is definitely not the place for that (he is not eating much here). He needs to be eating regularly, relaxing, and feeling safe again in a home where he can decompress and rediscover the sweet companion we know is still in there.


Are you willing to give this gentle giant a chance?

name: Poppa
description_html:
Meet Poppa ~ this panda look alike is a softie in fur and in heart. He's just joined team shelter and we would love to make his stay a short one. He's lived as an indoors pet for his lifetime, and most recently his brother was an aged mini pinscher. He's house trained and crate trained and can stay home alone well on his own. He knows quite a few commands too. Did you know many older dogs know over 100 words?

Poppa is easy to walk on a leash and doesn't demand a lot of coddling to be your loyal friend. Are you looking for one? He'll be right here waiting to meet you.

name: Potato Chip
description_html: Potato Chip came to the shelter after seemingly being dumped in an area and relying on the kindness of strangers for food. He's a gentle, sensitive guy who enjoys pets and seems like he's known what a home was at some point in life! He enjoys the company of other cats and has been added to our Cactus Cat program for shy kitties so he can get extra attention from volunteers. Potato Chip would love to feel the comforts of a home again very soon.

This beautiful mama brought her litter to me on July 31st. She seemed so desperate and exhausted but determined to survive. She’s a stunning, golden girl with emerald green eyes. I have been calling her “Siren” because she’s bewitching. She wants to be loved and likes for you to get down on her level for intense snuggles, while she makes biscuits.

When she’s feeling relaxed, she prances 🥰
This little guy is super fluffy and frisky

This wee one may be the sweetest boy of all time!

He really loves to snuggle. He’s proof that DYNOMITE comes in small packages.
Fluffy, sweet boy!

Such a pretty boy, this one is!

Very playful and friendly.

His markings are stunning

This little girl is out numbered by 4 brothers but can hold her own!

She’s a bit shy but with gentle encouragement she comes around and enjoys pets & snuggling.

name: Willow
description_html:
Meet Willow ~ a mild, lovely lady. Here's some things we're learned about her so far;

-She'll get on the furniture with you, only if she's invited

-She likes to be petted and tolerates brushing her fur

-Hotdogs are a favorite for her

-She's been sharing her kennel with a dog friend

-She's calm near everyone, including kids she sees

-She appears to be house trained and she's also crate trained

She's spayed, heart worm negative, vaccinated and is ready to go home right away. Ask staff or a volunteer for help getting her out so you can meet this top notch lady.

name: Monarch
description_html:
🦋 Meet Monarch! 🦋


Monarch is as lovely as her name suggests, but it’s her sweet, easygoing nature that truly shines.

She arrived as a stray and, despite the stress of intake and all the noise and activity around her, she let our staff carry her around like a total sweetheart.


With barking dogs and a busy shelter environment all around her, Monarch stayed impressively calm—we’d say this gorgeous girl is pretty chill! Now she’s hoping for a loving forever home where she can finally relax and be cherished. Come meet Monarch and let this beautiful butterfly land in your heart! 🦋❤️

name: Pup
description_html:
Meet Pup! 🐾 If you're looking for a dog for your dog, look no further! Pup absolutely LOVES having canine friends around. He lives for wrestling matches, backyard zoomies, and following his older foster siblings around. We think he'd thrive in a home with a playful dog sibling who can keep him company and show him the ropes.

At around 6 months to 1 year old, Pup is still very much a puppy, but he's a fast learner, highly food motivated, and will do just about anything for a treat. He's making great progress with potty training and crate training.

We found Pup wandering in our neighborhood and, despite our best efforts, were unable to locate his previous family. Now, this happy, healthy young pup is looking for a loving family to call his own!

name: Grace
description_html:
Meet Grace! 🐾


Grace arrived at our shelter as a stray, like so many cats who have had to fend for themselves outdoors. She was a little unthrifty—not quite thriving in the outdoor life.


Thankfully, Grace is now safe indoors, and she’s showing us what a difference a little kindness can make. She’s friendly, enjoys being petted, and is ready for the next chapter of her life. Will someone give Grace a little grace? ❤️


She deserves a safe, loving indoor home where she can relax, be cherished, and finally thrive. Could that home be yours?

name: Lorelei
description_html:
Lorelei Just Needs a Little Time 💕🐾


When Lorelei arrived at the shelter, she was very scared—and very vocal about it. But there’s an important distinction: she wasn’t being aggressive. She was simply overwhelmed and frightened.


At just nine months old, Lorelei is in that in-between stage—no longer a tiny kitten, but still very much a young girl with so much growing and learning ahead of her.


What Lorelei needs most right now isn’t a busy shelter environment. She needs a quiet, patient home where she can decompress, feel safe, and discover that people can be trusted. We have a feeling that once Lorelei feels secure, we’ll get to meet the real cat hiding behind all that fear.


Could you be the person willing to give this young girl the time she needs to relax and show her true self? 🏡

name: David
description_html:
🐾💙 Meet David — A Sweetheart Who Just Needed a Little Time 


When David first arrived, he was understandably nervous—but he was a total gentleman, allowing staff to do everything he needed (vaccines, microchip scan, and more) without protest. 


Now that he’s settled in, his true personality is shining through. David has soft, relaxed body language, leans into pets, and is showing just how affectionate he really is. 


From shy newcomer to sweet boy, David is now ready for his next step: a forever home where he can feel safe and loved. 🏡🐱

name: Cookie Bear
description_html:
Cookie Bear Is Ready for a Better Life! 🍪🐻


Sweet Cookie Bear arrived at the shelter as a stray, and the scabs on the back of his neck are a sad reminder that life on the streets can be hard. 💔


But despite whatever Cookie Bear has been through, this sweet cat deserves a chance at something better. He may not be a fan of being picked up—and honestly, not every cat is! 😸—but otherwise, Cookie Bear is a lovely, gentle cat who is ready to leave shelter life behind.

name: Ross
description_html:
Ross Deserves So Much Better 🐾


Sweet Ross was found abandoned in a carrier. We’ll never understand how someone could leave a cat behind like that. 💔


Ross is neutered, so we know he once had someone he belonged to. And understandably, he was quite scared when he arrived at the shelter. Being picked up wasn’t on his list of favorite things, but after what he’s been through, who could blame him?


Ross needs someone willing to give him the chance to feel safe again. He deserves a home where he will never be abandoned, forgotten, or left wondering what happened to his family. 🏡❤️

name: Samba
description_html:
Meet Samba 🐾


Samba was terrified when he first arrived at the shelter. But then a volunteer stopped to talk to him—and something wonderful happened. ❤️


Samba started rolling around, cautiously accepted some head pets, rubbed his face against the corner of the litter box, and practically melted for cheek scratches. He even enjoyed gentle strokes along his back.


Samba is still a little nervous in the shelter environment, which is completely understandable. But underneath that initial fear is a friendly, affectionate cat who is already showing us how much he wants to connect with people.


Could you be the person Samba has been waiting for? 🏡💛

name: Sir Meows
description_html: Sir Meows is a cuddly boy who will nudge you for pets and lean into them. He may just take a moment to get to know new people. We're not gonna lie, he's a bit awkward in new situations, but it's very endearing! He may do best in a home with other friendly cats to teach him how to "cat" properly. Sir Meows is ready to explore a safe space where he will be embraced for who he is. Adopt this affectionate guy today!

name: Brosnan
description_html:
💙 Brosnan Needs Someone to Believe in Him 


When Brosnan first arrived, he was absolutely terrified. He’s still shy, but he’s slowly starting to relax—and that’s a big step forward. Brosnan needs patience, kindness, and a safe home where he can learn to trust people.


This handsome boy has so much potential just waiting to shine through. With the right person, we know he can continue to blossom and feel safe and loved. The most patient homes often get the most rewarding companions. 🏡❤️

name: Hugs
description_html:
Meet Hugs ~ his owner suffered a setback which made caring for him impossible. He lived in a condo and would go out for 4 short walks daily. Besides his VIP, his very best friend was a siamese/ragdoll cat. They shared 4 years together. He's said to stay home alone well for a few hours. He likes children and he's not yappy except to alert to large dogs he sees while on walks, and he'll be happy to alert you when a visitor comes by the house.


Hugs is ready to meet his future, will you be his bridge? Come meet him in person between 11-6 by joining the customer service queue. Hugs is vaccinated, neutered and ready to pack his bags right away.

name: Fiona
description_html:
Fiona Deserves a Home Again 🩷


Nine-year-old Fiona has found herself at the shelter through no fault of her own. Her beloved owner passed away, and sadly, there was no family member able to take her in. With no one left to tell us her story, we don’t know much about Fiona’s life before this.

What we do know is that after spending her whole life in a home, the shelter is no place for a senior kitty. She is shy here but gets comfort from human interaction. She loves head scratches, will make biscuits, and purrs.

At nine years old, Fiona deserves a soft bed, a quiet place to decompress, and someone who will give her the patience and love she needs to feel safe again. She has already lost the person she knew as home. Please help us find Fiona a home she will never have to leave.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Fiona and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Ghost
description_html: Named for her habit of tiptoe-ing around the house, watching her people from afar, and moving things around when no one's watching, Ghost is a shy girl who would make the perfect companion in a calm home. She was found wandering around a neighborhood, but she has quickly adapted to being a house pet. She is potty trained, spends most of her time lounging on the couch or in her crate, and is figuring out how to play with her foster brother. Once she's comfortable around her people, she loves getting as many belly rubs as she can. Due to her previous street-life skills, a secure fence is needed when she is outside unmonitored.

name: Ferguson
description_html:
❤️ Ferguson Needs a Safe Place to Land


When Ferguson was brought in by an Animal Protection Officer, he was in rough shape. He had a bad upper respiratory infection and what appears to be a traumatic injury to his tail. He must have been feeling absolutely miserable — but despite everything, Ferguson was still friendly with our intake staff. 🥺


He’s now in our URI section, where he’s getting the care and rest he needs to recover. He can be a little shy right now, but we have a feeling that as he starts feeling better, his friendly personality will come shining through.


Ferguson has already been through enough. He deserves to recover in a loving home. 🏡❤️

name: Avery
description_html:
💕 Aero & Avery Need a Fresh Start


Aero and Avery were abandoned, but thankfully, a kind neighbor noticed them and called for help. When an Animal Protection Officer arrived, both cats were frightened and hiding in cabinets. It took some patience, but they were eventually brought to safety. 


Shelter life has been scary for these two, but Avery has decided she’s done hiding! ❤️ When we tried to get a better photo of her, she actually sauntered right out of her kennel. It was such a wonderful little breakthrough — Avery is ready to start making friends! Poor Aero is still struggling. He’s hiding under his bedding and needs someone who understands that trust takes time. 💔


These two have already experienced the fear and uncertainty of being abandoned. Now they need patience, kindness, and a safe home where they can decompress and discover that life can be good again. Whether they are adopted together or separately, we want Aero and Avery to know they are safe and loved. Avery is ready to come out and meet you. Aero just needs someone willing to wait for him.

name: Perlay
description_html:
Perlay is an absolutely beautiful, gentle girl who is as easygoing as they come. She walks beautifully on a loose leash, is easy to handle, and enjoys taking her time to sniff and explore. She was neutral toward both people and dogs, and even when startled by an unexpected bark, she recovered quickly.


Perlay is brand new to the shelter and can be a little shy, so she’ll do best with a patient family willing to give her time to settle in and feel comfortable. She also appears strongly bonded to her buddy, Papucho, and we would love to see these two sweet souls find a home together. Give them a little time to adjust, and they’ll repay you with plenty of love. Perlay may just become your favorite chill girl!


Adoption traits: Independent, leash trained, medium energy, gentle, shy, and affectionate.

name: Sunny
description_html:
☀️ Sunny didn’t choose to be here—she’s hoping someone will choose her. ❤️


Sunny came to the shelter through no fault of her own after a change in family circumstances. We don’t know much about her past, but we do know she’s a beautiful, shy girl who needs a patient, loving home to help her feel safe again.


And that little bobtail is just adorable! 😍 She may do best as a one-and-only cat, as she was a little upset with her shelter neighbor.


Sunny’s world has already been turned upside down. Now she just needs someone to give her a second chance.

name: Papucho
description_html:
Papucho is an absolute joy! This handsome, gentle guy is easygoing, slightly less shy, and loves nothing more than moseying along on a walk or sniffing around the play yard. He is a loose-leash walker, neutral with both people and dogs, and simply enjoys exploring at his own pace.


Papucho is bonded with Perlay, and their sweet connection is impossible to miss. When she was startled by a loud bark, Papucho immediately checked in on her. They clearly came from a loving home and have so much love to give in return. We would love to see these two stay together!


Papucho is housetrained, laid-back, independent, and leash trained. He’s an absolute sweetheart and would be a wonderful companion for the lucky person who takes him home.

name: Vivienne
description_html:
Vivienne Didn’t Deserve to Be Left Behind 💔


Vivienne was found abandoned in an apartment. She is microchipped, and we made every effort to reach her owner, but sadly, our calls and messages went unanswered.


Now this sweet girl is left trying to make sense of a world that suddenly changed. Vivienne is understandably confused and scared, but underneath that uncertainty is a sweet girl who deserves to feel safe again.


What Vivienne needs now is someone who will be patient with her, give her time to decompress, and most importantly, never give up on her. ❤️

name: Valentina
description_html:
Meet Valentina! 💕


This beautiful girl is every bit as sweet as her name. Valentina was an absolute sweetheart at intake—even while dealing with an upper respiratory infection. Our veterinary team got her straight into treatment, and she’s doing well and feeling better. 


She’s friendly, a little chatty, and ready to trade her time in treatment for something much better: a forever home! If you’re looking for a beautiful, affectionate girl who isn’t afraid to tell you what she thinks, Valentina could be your perfect match. 🐾

name: Sister
description_html:
Hi, I’m Sister! After spending a couple of weeks on the streets of Austin, my siblings and I were brought to safety, and my loving, trusting personality has shone through from day one. I’m a resilient, total people-lover who is ready for my fresh start in a forever home!

The Good Stuff (My House Manners):

  • Potty & Crate Trained: Yep, I’ve got these down! I even kennel up like a pro for breakfast, dinner, or a yummy treat.
  • Smart Cookie: I’m a quick learner and already know sit, come, and kennel up. We’re currently practicing our leash walks, lay down, and stay.
  • Dog & Human Friendly: I get along great with my foster dog brothers and adore every human I meet.

My Ideal Home:

I am the ultimate balance of a goofy puppy and a gentle companion. My favorite motto is "play hard, sleep harder" I love having fun with my dog friends, but once playtime is over, my signature move is resting my chin right on your lap while you read a book or watch TV.

If you are looking for a smart, affectionate, and eager-to-learn puppy who will follow you anywhere and fill your home with laughs and snuggles, Sister is your girl!

name: Toast
description_html:
Hi, I’m Toast! After spending a couple of weeks on the streets of Austin with my siblings, I was brought to safety and my curious, trusting personality has shone through from day one. I’m a resilient, fun-loving boy who is ready for my fresh start in a forever home!

The Good Stuff (My House Manners):

  • Potty & Crate Trained: I’ve got my routines down! I’m super treat-motivated and happily kennel up like a pro for meals or a tasty snack.
  • Smart Cookie: Just like my sister, I’m a quick learner! I already know sit, come, and kennel up. We’re currently practicing leash walks, lay down, and stay.
  • Dog & Human Friendly: I absolutely love playing and cuddling up with my foster dog brothers, and I’m always ready to make new human friends.

My Ideal Home:

I am a curious, energetic boy who loves to stay busy! My favorite activities include running around, playing with a good chew toy, and heading out on walks to explore the neighborhood. But don't let all that fun fool you! Once I’ve burned off my energy, my absolute favorite thing in the world is a good sunbath followed by a warm cuddle session.

If you’re looking for a smart, eager-to-learn, and adventurous pup to brighten up your life, Toast is ready to meet you!

name: Camille
description_html:
🐾💕 Meet Camille & Marketa! 💕🐾


These two sweet girls were brought to the shelter by a kind person who wanted to give them a chance at a better life than the streets. Understandably, they were both frightened when they arrived—and to make things even harder, they ended up in separate kennels.


Thankfully, they were reunited, and what a difference it has made! 🥹💗


Now that Camille and Marketa are together again, they seem so much more comfortable, relaxed, and happy. Both girls are affectionate, with Camille being a little more outgoing and Marketa taking a bit more time to warm up.


They can be adopted separately or together, but seeing how much confidence and comfort they give each other, we’d absolutely love for them to find a home together if possible. 🏡🐱🐱

name: Marketa
description_html:
🐾💕 Meet Camille & Marketa! 💕🐾


These two sweet girls were brought to the shelter by a kind person who wanted to give them a chance at a better life than the streets. Understandably, they were both frightened when they arrived—and to make things even harder, they ended up in separate kennels.


Thankfully, they were reunited, and what a difference it has made! 🥹💗


Now that Camille and Marketa are together again, they seem so much more comfortable, relaxed, and happy. Both girls are affectionate, with Camille being a little more outgoing and Marketa taking a bit more time to warm up.


They can be adopted separately or together, but seeing how much confidence and comfort they give each other, we’d absolutely love for them to find a home together if possible. 🏡🐱🐱

name: Heidi
description_html:
Meet Heidi, Your New Best Friend! 🐾


When Heidi first arrived, she was absolutely terrified. But now she’s a sweet, affectionate little cat who actively seeks out attention. In fact, Heidi makes it hard to clean her kennel because she would much rather be getting ALL the love. And if you like a chatty cat, Heidi is your girl—she loves to talk and has a lot to say!


From scared to snuggly chatterbox, Heidi has come so far. Now she just needs a family who will enjoy her cuddles, her conversation, and her big personality.


Looking for a loving cat who will keep you company and chat about her day? Heidi is waiting for you! 🏡💗

name: Junie
description_html:
Meet Junie!


Junie has been loving and gentle since the moment she arrived, and she’s now hoping someone will see past a potential medical concern and see her.


Her left eye shows corneal pigmentation. It does not appear to be causing her pain or discomfort, but we recommend a future veterinary check-up, as eye conditions can sometimes change over time. Junie just needs someone willing to love her and keep an eye on her health. ❤️


If you’re looking for a sweet companion and have room in your heart for a truly special girl, please come meet Junie. 🐾

name: Honey
description_html: Honey is a very loving and playful girl who enjoys cuddling with you or playing fetch with tiny tennis balls. She walks well on a leash. She also gets along with cats and other small dogs. Goes potty outside and on a pee pad. Sleeps in a crate at night.

name: Stroop
description_html:
Meet Stroop (short for Stroopwafel)! 🧇

Weight: 55 lbs

Found Near: Barton Springs Pool area on 08/04

Stroop is a happy, gentle guy who has been a joy to foster. He weighs about 55 lbs, loves people, and makes friends everywhere he goes.


Personality & Household:

• House Trained: Fully house-trained with zero accidents.

• Night Routine: Sleeps quietly through the whole night.

• Home Alone: Free-roams during the day without any issues. No crate needed.

• Energy Level: Medium energy. He enjoys daily walks and playtime, then settles down easily.

• Dog Friendly: Gets along well with other dogs and currently lives with a resident dog.


Leash & Training:

Stroop is very food motivated, so training him is easy and rewarding. He is still working on leash manners. He gets excited when he sees squirrels, rabbits, or other dogs on walks because he wants to go say hi, but it is purely friendly excitement.


Health & Medical:

• Vaccinated (Rabies, Distemper, Parvo)

• Heartworm Negative

• Up-to-date on Flea & Tick preventatives

• Scheduled to be neutered via Austin Animal Center

(Note: Stroop has not been tested around cats or young kids yet.)

If you are looking for a cheerful, friendly companion, Stroop is ready to meet you!

name: Hammer Time
description_html:
Hammer Time is a chill, happy boy who is all about pets, love, and treats! He’s very easy to handle on leash, enjoying mild pulling while he sniffs and explores. He politely ignores both people and dogs around him and stays focused on enjoying his walk.


In the Real Life Room, Hammer Time is especially sweet and affectionate. He loves getting pets and treats and would make a wonderful companion and couch buddy. He’s treat motivated, laid-back, cuddly, and ready to give his person plenty of love. 🐾

name: Kermit
description_html: A little shy but warms up fast and becomes very talkative. Loves cuddles and face rubs. Can be a little jumpy but seems to be improving. Is interested in other cats and would like benefit from a cat buddy.

name: Mina
description_html: Super sweet, timid girl! Loves chin scratches!

name: Flo-Jo
description_html:
Meet Flo-Jo — there’s a sweet girl behind those scared eyes. 💕


Flo-Jo is a curious girl who enjoys gentle pets, purrs happily, and will even give your hand a soft little paw when she’s feeling comfortable. 


She earned her name when she bolted out of her kennel while we were cleaning — and boy, was she FAST! It took quite a while to get her safely back inside, and understandably, the whole experience left poor Flo-Jo frightened.


But we know that fear isn’t the whole story. Behind that scared exterior is a sweet, curious girl who wants to connect. Flo-Jo just needs someone willing to go at her pace, earn her trust, and show her that she’s safe. Could you be the patient person who helps Flo-Jo come out of her shell? 🏡🐱

name: Winky
description_html:
📸 Meet Winky—the handsome boy who was born to be adored! 🐾


Winky is laid-back, friendly, and seriously photogenic. He knows how to strike a pose, but this charming boy isn’t looking for a modeling career—he’s looking for something much more important: a forever home. And here’s the best part: Winky LOVES being held like a baby! 🥹 Talk about a cat who knows how to melt hearts.


Right now, Winky is being treated for an upper respiratory infection, and true to his sweet nature, he’s being an absolute model patient while he gets better. Once he’s ready to head home, Winky will be looking for someone who will give him all the love, cuddles, and attention he deserves.

Could you be Winky’s perfect match? Come meet this handsome, charming boy.

name: Diesel
description_html:
Diesel loves everyone, he's great with people, kids and dogs but says "no siree" to cats! He has nice active energy for play and loves walks, playing with squeaky toys & balls, and playing with other dogs.

He was just tested in playgroups at the shelter and was very polite with playful greets. He engaged in soft play with the dogs most of the session. He's sharing space with a kennel friend now.

He's very house trained and knows the verbal cues. Short video here

Diesel has so much to offer that makes him an easy drop into a new home.


A common question - why is this dog here? Diesel is a native of Oregon who relocated with his people to Austin and lived in a condo with a beagle friend. Unfortunate housing circumstances dealt the family a setback.

name: Augie
description_html:
💙 Meet Augie—a scared boy with a sweet heart. 


When Augie first arrived, he was terrified—crouched low with huge eyes. He was found outside our shelter, abandoned on our campus. But he never showed aggression, just fear.


Now we’re starting to see glimpses of the real Augie. 🥹 When volunteers approach, he sometimes rolls over and starts making biscuits—a hopeful little sign that he’s trying to trust. He’s still shy and wary of hands, but he’s making progress every day. With one of our highly experienced volunteers, he turned from airplane ears to a lap cat---we know he can get there with the right person!


Augie needs a patient adopter who will let him go at his own pace and help him learn that people are safe. He’s scared. He’s trying. And he deserves someone who will believe in him.

name: Pickle
description_html: Pickle is a sweet, curious little guy with a friendly personality and lots of interest in the world around him! He has done wonderfully with my two-year-old cat, Maverick, and enjoys having a feline friend around. Pickle is litter-box trained and has been a great little houseguest. He’s affectionate, social, and always ready to investigate whatever is going on. Pickle would make a wonderful addition to a loving home looking for a sweet and curious companion!

name: Kona
description_html:
Follow Kona's Progress On Instagram


Kona is a sweet & playful puppy who's ready to love her people. She settles down really well at night after some exercise, and sleeps quietly on a bed or in her crate area next to you. She also appears potty trained! She’s shy towards people, but once she gets to know them she seems to really open up. She also hasn’t seemed to meet a dog she doesn’t like, and she’s played great with her foster siblings!

Like many young dogs adjusting to new environments, she's still working on a couple of things. She's learning that the world outside the backyard isn't so scary. Neighborhood walks and the car are new and a little overwhelming for her right now. She's already shown how quickly she learns, and with a little patience, she's going to love going on adventures. While at her fosters' she'll continue to work hard on these things, and on basic obedience commands.

What she needs most is someone who understands that trust and confidence grow with kindness, consistency, and encouragement. In return, you'll get a loyal companion who wants nothing more than to be by your side. She also I think would love a confident sibling to play with and maybe help her see that walks are pretty awesome too!

If you're a patient family who is wanting to help give a young dog a new "leash" on life, she'd love to meet you!

name: Ember
description_html:
Meet Ember 🧡


Sweet Ember arrived with her two adorable tabby kittens and has been a loving, devoted mom. She is a young, friendly cat who enjoys affection and human company.


Now that her kittens are ready for their own homes, Ember is ready for a life of her own—filled with cozy indoor comforts, soft beds, and plenty of love.


If you're looking for a sweet, gentle companion, Ember is ready to meet you!

name: Vlad
description_html:
At first glance, you will likely notice Vlad’s gorgeous all-black coat, but his purr-sonality is even more priceless!


He may be perceived as shy when first meeting him, but he desperately wants to be around you. Vlad’s favorite way to show affection toward his human companions is by sitting on their lap or laying on their chest, purring loudly, making biscuits on their face, and licking their nose. Vlad LOVES noses so much that he sometimes cannot help but give them a little nibble. We are working to deter this by making a “tss!” sound when the teeth come out and keeping him lower on our chests. Thankfully, he is starting to understand!


Despite his affinity for lounging in your lap and on your chest, Vlad is still learning to be held. At times, he can be picked up like a baby and given pets, but sometimes he will struggle a bit. Interestingly, he will push against you while attempting to escape your grasp, but he does not use his claws. Once back on solid ground, he occasionally gives a single hiss, but then immediately continues seeking full-body pets (yes - belly too!) and play. 


Even quirkier than his obsession with noses, Vlad is an extraordinarily chatty man who likes the sound of his own voice, even when he doesn’t need anything. We joke that he is exploring his space through echolocation. 


When his humans aren’t around, Vlad usually lounges on the bed, showing off the rich brown color his coat becomes when illuminated by sunlight. 


Vlad has been offered both wet and dry food; however, he seems to have little to no interest in dry food, opting for an almost entirely wet-food-based diet. He is hoping that his new home would be open to catering to these preferences too.


Vlad has excellent bathroom manners, takes diligent care of his coat, and does not have any observed health concerns. He was neutered on Wednesday 08/05 and has healed well.


Vlad would greatly benefit from having a feline friend and seems much more relaxed with some company! Additionally, because he’s so loving, we do think Vlad may be good with older children, but likely only those that can understand a little nibble. 


Please reach out if you are interested in Vlad!

name: Barbara
description_html:
Barbara’s life changed suddenly when her beloved owner passed away, and she and her sister Meredith Grey came to the shelter with no family able to take them in.😔


Unlike her outgoing sister, Barbara was more reserved and took time to warm up to new people. But she has come out of her shell, showing a gentle, sweet nature beneath her shy exterior. She will thrive in a calm home where she can feel safe and settle in at her own pace. Meredith Gray has been adopted, so now Barbara is waiting for her turn.


If you have a soft spot for shy cats, Barbara is ready for a second chance at love and security. 💖🏡

name: Petunia
description_html:
Petunia is the kind of dog who wants to be everyone's friend. She loves people and is always hoping someone will stop to give her a few pets. Her sweet, social personality makes it easy to fall in love with her.


She appears to be housetrained, walks well on an Easy Walk harness with only mild pulling, and enjoys taking her time sniffing and exploring on walks. Petunia is curious about both people and other dogs and greets the world with friendly enthusiasm. She also has a playful side and would thrive with a family that can include her in everyday adventures.


If you're looking for an affectionate companion who loves to cuddle, enjoys being around people, and is ready for her forever home, Petunia is waiting to meet you.

name: Beau
description_html:
Beau is the kind of dog who makes it easy to fall in love. This sweet boy is a loose-leash walker who enjoys taking his time to sniff and explore the world around him. He seems housetrained and has a gentle, affectionate nature—he's happiest when he's getting pets and soaking up all the love you have to give.


While Beau can be barrier reactive in his kennel when other dogs pass by, he showed a completely different side once outside, calmly ignoring other dogs on his walk. Shelter life can be stressful, but out in the open he's an easygoing companion who just wants to enjoy a nice stroll and spend time with his people.


If you're looking for a cuddly, loving best friend who enjoys leisurely walks and plenty of affection, Beau may be the perfect match!

name: George
description_html:
George is an easy dog to fall for. Even when he was staying in the crate room, he kept his space neat and tidy, often relaxing with his paws crossed like a perfect gentleman. He was great about letting volunteers know when he needed to go outside, which suggests he may be housetrained.


On walks, George is a loose leash walker with only mild pulling when something catches his attention. He enjoys sniffing and exploring, checks in often with his handler, and is curious but friendly around both people and other dogs. He's playful, happy, and always seems ready to have fun.


George has quickly become a volunteer favorite thanks to his sweet personality, easy leash manners, and joyful spirit. If you're looking for a playful companion who's just as happy exploring the world as he is spending time with his people, George is ready to meet you.

name: Tiger
description_html: Tiger is a good boy with a troubled past. He was moved into a new home and found it hard to adapt, then he ended up at the shelter. Tiger is affectionate and loves pets, though he appreciates if you go slowly with first meetings. He's pretty scared in the shelter so we'd love to get him into a home ASAP where he can relax and be allowed to adjust at his own pace. He's lived with dogs in the past so may do well in a home with a canine friend. Help a Tiger out today!

name: Maiev
description_html:
After six years in a home, Maiev was sadly left behind. Thankfully, caring neighbors stepped in—one made sure she was fed, and another reached out for help.


Despite everything, Maiev remains a sweet, affectionate cat with so much love left to give. She’s gentle, grateful, and ready for a quiet forever home where she can finally feel safe and cherished again.


Older cats like Maiev make deeply loyal companions, and she is hoping for someone to give her the second chance she truly deserves.

name: Velma
description_html:
Before long, Velma will have you wondering how you ever lived without her. This gentle, laid-back girl is the definition of an easy companion. She's a loose-leash walker who loves treats, checks in often with her person, and happily soaks up all the pets and affection you have to give.

Velma seems housetrained, ignores both people and other dogs on walks, and has a calm, sweet nature that makes spending time with her a joy. Though she can be a little shy at first, she warms up quickly with a gentle approach and is an easy "clip and go" pup once she's ready. If you're looking for a loyal best friend who will happily stroll by your side and then relax with you at home, Velma is ready to fill that role.

name: Bella
description_html: Bella is a sweet little lady of less than 30 lbs who came into the shelter needing safety and while there became sick with a common dog cold, called an upper respiratory infection (URI). It became stubborn and Bella needed some extra time and care to recover. She's just left for a foster home to finish in comfort. Bella is an affectionate, tender lady who loves close relationships and doesn't mind dog friends nearby. Keep her in mind if you've looking because we expect she'll be ready to go places very soon! You can submit an inquiry to stay in touch with the latest.

name: Luna
description_html:
Luna lived for the last several months with adults and teens, in an apartment setting, getting walks daily. She was quiet there, except during meal times, her favorite times of the day!

Luna knows some things like sit, shake and paw and she stayed home alone well when the family was gone for 1-3 hrs at a time. She likes having her own dog bed.

Outside Luna passes other large dogs easily. At the shelter Luna has been play group tested and shares her kennel with a dog friend her size.

Luna is ready to exchange her kennel to become a new family member.

Ask to meet her.

name: Senora
description_html:
Meet Senora, a cat with a big personality and an even bigger voice!


She came to the shelter when her owner no longer had time to care for her, but they described her as sweet, playful, cuddly, and very talkative.


Senora’s raspy meow is unforgettable—she’s basically a little rock star (we’ve joked she could be Stevie Nicks!).🎤🎶


Beyond her voice, she’s a loving companion who enjoys attention, playtime, and being close to her people. If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate cat with lots of charm, Senora is ready to meet you.

name: Smudge
description_html: A bit shy and sassy at first, but once she feels comfortable with you she LOVES to be pet!

name: Sigourney (petco)
description_html:
Sigourney is available for adoption at Petco Lakeline! Go there to meet her.


Sigourney did everything a good mom should do—now she deserves a home of her own. 💕🐾


She arrived at the shelter with her two kittens, a little scared but caring for them beautifully. Both kittens have since been adopted, but Sigourney is still waiting. She’s a young, sweet cat with so much love left to give. After raising her babies, she deserves a safe, loving home where she can finally relax and enjoy sleeping on sofas and watching the world go by. She is extremely affectionate, loves pets and cuddles and has seemed relaxed around other cats.


Please don’t overlook this laid-back mama. Come meet Sigourney today!❤️🏡

name: Julius
description_html:
Julius is handsome and very sweet! When he arrived at AAS, he had a right femoral fracture, which was repaired with a pin, plate and screws. He then moved into a foster home for supportive care. He has made a complete recovery and has resumed normal activity without any issues.

Julius is playful, and gets along wonderfully with other cats. He may be a little shy at first, but he warms up quickly. He will do best in a quiet home, with or without a cat buddy. He loves being petted, and is a huge purr machine.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Julius and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Monte
description_html:
The shelter is no place for a 13-year old cat. 💔🐾

Meet Monte, a sweet senior boy who arrived as a stray. He’s clearly been someone’s beloved companion. But instead of a cozy home, Monte is spending his days in a kennel—and he deserves so much more.

Senior cats like Monte have endless love to give. He just needs a soft place to land, a warm bed, and a family to spend his golden years with. Please don’t let Monte wait any longer. He is available for foster or adoption. Come meet him today! ❤️🏡

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Monte and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Beaux
description_html:
Beaux is a high-energy cuddlebug with an impressive brain and an enormous capacity for affection. His former owner says he loves curling up right beside his person and will lie there contentedly for as long as the pets continue. When it is time to get moving, Beaux is ready for running, fetch, tug-of-war, walks, squeaky toys, stuffed toys, or a good chew bone.


Beaux has already learned 'sit', 'down', 'come', 'look at me', and can even bark on cue! Recent shelter outings have shown that he can be an excellent loose-leash walker. He has also participated successfully in shelter playgroup, where he ran into the yard, enjoyed push-pull play, and was paired with a doggy roommate. Beaux has potential to live with a well-matched canine companion, so ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


Beaux recently met a family with four children ages nine through seventeen and appeared to be living his best life—allowing everyone to pet him and leaning against them to request even more affection.


His former owner reported that Beaux could be wary of unfamiliar people, particularly when someone entered his home or approached too quickly. He does best with calm, gradual introductions, preferably outside the home, and may need a little time to decide that a new person is a friend. Once that happens, his former owner said he becomes thrilled to see them.


An active family that can provide structure, daily exercise and enrichment, and positive training will help this affectionate, clever dog thrive. Think that could be you? Come meet this sweet boy!

name: Buck
description_html:
Buck’s former family summed up his best quality in three words: “Good dog, period.” This friendly, energetic boy is house-trained and reportedly did well when left alone for short periods, whether he was loose in the home or chilling in a crate.


Buck loves practically every dog activity he has encountered: fetch, tug-of-war, chase, walks, squeaky toys, and chew bones. He already knows 'sit', 'stay', and 'come' and will be happiest with a family ready to provide regular exercise, playtime, and opportunities to keep learning.


Buck also has excellent dog experience. He previously lived with another large dog successfully and during his shelter playgroup evaluation, he offered polite greetings and quickly settled into soft play with the other dogs. Buck could be a wonderful addition to a multi-dog home—ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


His former owner also described him as playful with cats. Slow introductions and thoughtful supervision would still be important in a new home. As a young dog, Buck can be exuberant. His enthusiasm should be a great match for an active adopter looking for a cheerful playmate and adventure partner. Looking to add a new adventure buddy to your family? Come meet this sweet pup!

name: Snow
description_html:
Snow is a quiet, friendly girl with an impressive amount of home experience. In a home setting, she is housetrained and can remain loose in the house alone for several hours and remain on her best behavior! She routinely slept in a crate overnight and already knows 'sit', 'stay', and 'come'.


Snow has also lived with another dog and is playful with dogs both big and small. She has also participated in shelter playgroup and been paired with a doggy roommate. Snow was initially timid when entering the play yard for her first play group, but she tolerated enthusiastic greetings from other dogs and began exploring once she felt more comfortable. She may be a lovely match for a canine companion given a little time to settle in!


Her former owner also described Snow as playful around cats. As always, slow introductions and supervision will help everyone adjust successfully in a new home.


Snow enjoys chase, wrestling, squeaky toys, and chew bones. She even reportedly enjoys baths, being picked up, and having her nails trimmed! Snow may start out a little shy, but her quiet nature, excellent home skills, and friendly personality give her all the ingredients of a wonderful companion.

name: Horacio
description_html:
Horacio may be feeling shy in the shelter, but give him the chance to settle in and another side of him begins to appear. This handsome shepherd has shown that beneath his initial uncertainty is a dog who can relax, socialize, and enjoy himself.


One place Horacio has really started to shine is around other dogs. During a recent shelter playgroup, he showed quiet interest from the catch pen, chose to enter the yard on his own, offered nice greetings, and went on to play with other AAC dogs Missy and Boss. He was comfortable enough afterward to be paired with a doggy roommate, too. Horacio may be a wonderful candidate for a home with a well-matched canine companion—ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs.


Horacio can be fearful when first entering an unfamiliar environment, so he will appreciate adopters who understand that first impressions aren’t always the whole dog. Calm handling, patience, and the freedom to approach new experiences at his own pace should help him build confidence.


For someone willing to give a shy dog a little time to unfold, Horacio could be an especially rewarding friend—and his growing comfort with other dogs may help him feel at home even faster. Come meet this shy sweetie today!

name: Dobby
description_html:
Dobby is a big, affectionate young dog with big puppy enthusiasm and an equally big heart. His human friends describe him as sweet and extremely affectionate. He loves fetch, tug-of-war, chase, and being involved in whatever his people are doing.


Dobby already knows 'sit', 'stay', and 'down'. In a home setting, he has done well with house-training and being crated when home alone. He previously lived with a three-year-old child and cats, and his family said he got along with them.


Dobby also has promising dog skills. During his first shelter playgroup, he was nervous about the initial greetings and asked the other dogs for some space. Once he realized he was safe, he relaxed and spent the rest of the session enjoying soft play. He has potential to live with a well-matched dog, so ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


At ten months old, Dobby is still very much a teenager. An active family prepared to provide exercise, training, appropriate chew toys, and gradual alone-time practice will be rewarded with an outgoing, playful, and deeply affectionate companion.

name: Zoey
description_html:
Zoey is not at her best right now. She may not like other cats, and she is stressed. She needs out of her kennel, either through adoption or foster.

Zoey lived in a home her entire life, and her owner described her as playful and friendly. She sometimes likes to be by herself, but otherwise she’s a lap cat. She is shy with new people, and is especially afraid of men (although she will eventually warm to them).

Zoey needs a quiet environment as the only pet with someone who will give her plenty of time to relax. Once she decompresses, she will be a wonderful companion.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Zoey and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Jefferson
description_html:
Jefferson is a laid-back, silly guy who enjoys taking life at a leisurely pace. He’s a fantastic walking companion if you prefer a slow stroll over a cardio workout! Jefferson is an excellent loose-leash walker and happily clips in and goes, with no pulling or reactivity toward people or other dogs.


He loves taking his time to sniff and explore, and he seems perfectly content entertaining himself in the yard. At the same time, he’s interested in interacting with his people and has a playful, comedic personality that is sure to make you smile. He’s calm and relaxed in his kennel and appears to be housetrained, too.


Jefferson could be a great fit for a variety of homes, including an apartment or condo, as long as he gets regular leisurely strolls and opportunities to explore. If you’re looking for an independent, easygoing companion with a goofy side, Jefferson might be your guy!

name: Donkey
description_html:
URGENT: Donkey's health condition is requiring him to leave the shelter before 8/13. Donkey has some aged conditions that make him not a great fit for staying in the shelter environment.

Donkey has a heart of gold. This sweet, underweight man quietly waits for his chance to stretch his legs and is a joy to spend time with. Easy to leash, he strolls calmly on walks, and happily ignores barking dogs as he takes in the world at a relaxed pace. He appears to be house trained. Ever heard the fable of the old man and his old donkey? Well this old donkey is not giving up, it's not his time!

name: Tintin
description_html: Tintin, with his handsome dark brindle coat, is a pup with a smile that lights up every room! With his perfectly balanced medium energy, Tintin is always up for a fun game of happily chasing down his favorite toys with classic, tail-wagging enthusiasm. Once playtime wraps up, this sweet boy instantly transitions into world-class cuddle mode, eager to lean right in and soak up all the affection you have to offer. Whether you’re heading out for a stroll or cozying up on the couch, Tintin is ready to be your ultimate best friend!

name: Jiji
description_html:
Jiji Is Still Waiting 💕


Jiji came to the shelter with her three siblings, and for a moment it looked like she was headed for a happy ending. She even spent time in foster care.


But after developing URI symptoms, the whole litter returned for treatment. Once they recovered, Jiji watched her siblings get adopted one by one… and she’s still waiting. 💔


She’s the shyest of the group, which often means she gets overlooked. But shy doesn’t mean she lacks love—it just means she may need a little extra patience to feel safe and shine. Jiji deserves a quiet, loving home where she can blossom at her own pace. 🏡💗

name: Gecko
description_html:
💔 Gecko is still waiting—and now he's waiting alone.


Gecko is a very shy kitty who has shown patience with volunteers, but still needs time to feel fully comfortable with people. He doesn’t seek out pets yet, but will allow gentle affection if you go slow—small steps that show trust is starting to grow. ❤️


Gecko used to find comfort in his sibling, Iggy, but Iggy has since been adopted, leaving Gecko without their familiar companion. This is a cat who may take time. He may not rush into your arms—but they still deserve a home. Gecko needs an experienced, patient adopter who understands shy cats and is willing to let trust build at Gecko’s pace.

name: Eduardo
description_html:
Eduardo is a new member of our Cactus Cat family! He's not spicy, he's just a scaredy cat in new situations. But, all you have to do is offer a hand and he will gladly accept pets and relax. He loves his cat friends so he may do best with a cat companion in his new home.

Eduardo is a former community cat who was not thriving and may have actually been abandoned previously. His left eye is small or missing due to a chronic issue. It's not giving him trouble now but his vision is likely limited to the right eye.

Eduardo needs a calm place to relax and come out of his shell at his own pace. He's a loving and affectionate boy with people he knows, and having a cat friend will likely speed up his acclimation.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Eduardo and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Bea
description_html:
Meet Bea – A Gentle Girl Waiting for Her Chance


Bea was brought to the shelter by a kind person who described her as very friendly. She was the perfect lady for our veterinary team during intake.


The shelter can be overwhelming, so Bea is a little shy here. But give this sweet girl a chance, and you'll see her gentle, loving personality shine through.


Bea just needs a quiet, caring home where she can feel safe and be herself. In return, she'll be a wonderful companion with a kind heart. Come meet Bea and see how special she is!

name: Bamboo
description_html:
Meet Bamboo, the incredible younger half of the pair Bamboo and Panda. They've been having loads of fun in their foster home, after losing their lifelong home due to a crisis. They are all about L.O.V.E and soft affections and are house trained and crate trained. Both have had some obedience training in their past and know basic commands.

Bamboo is best described as the class clown. His loves include playing fetch with his ball, taking a dip in the pool, being a tug of war champ with the humans but oh so delicate when playing with Panda. On Bamboo's wish list is a yard space big enough for fetch. Bamboo is very social causing him to be a little vocal as he calls out to possible friends.

Bamboo and Panda like to be together yet are also independent of one another. They are each vaccinated, spayed/neutered, and heart worm negative and ready for wonderful futures. If you are interested in Bamboo please apply on his link, and if you are also interested in Panda (30143), please apply on her link too.

name: Panda
description_html:
Meet Panda, the sweet little sister of Bamboo. They've been having loads of fun in a foster home, after losing their lifelong home due to a crisis. They are all about L.O.V.E and are incredibly social with their soft affections, seeking out sweet people and sweet friendly dogs. When the fun is done, they find their favorite comfort spots to rest and recharge. They are perfect house mates and are house trained and each has has had some obedience training in their past and know basic cues.

Panda is super affectionate and lives for the cuddles and petting and has super soft fur. Her loves include fetch, playing softly with stuffed toys, playing tug of war and watching TV, especially if dogs appear, she gets excited. Panda has had some cat experience in her former life.

She has plenty of energy and spunk to share.

Panda and Bamboo (30142) enjoy being with each other yet are independent of one another too, Each is vaccinated, spayed/neutered, heart worm negative and ready for a wonderful love filled life ahead. Please reach out on Panda's link to express an interest in meeting.

If you would like to also meet Bamboo (30142) please also reach out on his link.

Both dogs have received an extra level of wellness care that will benefit a new owner, provided by Classic Canines.

name: Haven
description_html:
Haven is a friendly young dog who is learning that the world can be a pretty fun place. She started out shy in shelter playgroup, but with a little time she blossomed into soft play with the other dogs and even began seeking affection from her handlers.


Haven may be a lovely match for a patient family—and potentially a well-matched canine friend—who can help her continue building confidence. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!

name: Wyatt
description_html:
Wyatt LOVES other cats, and will be happiest with a cat buddy! He also likes people, but he’s a little shy at first. He is a former community cat, and when he was brought to AAS, x-rays revealed a fracture to his left front leg. Because the injury was older, surgical correction was not an option.

Wyatt moved into a foster home for medical management (including weeks of crate rest). Follow up x-rays confirmed that the fracture has formed a good bony callous, and we don’t anticipate any issues in the future (he must live indoors). 

Wyatt needs a quiet environment, and some time to warm up. He likes being petted, but if you pet him too long, he’ll give a little nip or simply walk away.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Wyatt and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Oreo
description_html:
Double stuffed with affection and charm! Oreo’s perfect day includes window watching, chasing his fishing wand, enjoying treats, and lounging near his favorite people. This curious gentleman loves to know what’s happening around him and even though he may be a little shy initially, he is always ready to investigate something or someone new.

When he’s not exploring, Oreo is happily soaking up pets, and he’s just as eager to give affection right back.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Oreo and ALL Desperate Housecats!


Check out my Instagram!

name: Banana Cream
description_html:
Banana Cream is a shy-at-first sweetheart with a playful puppy hiding just beneath the surface. New situations can make her uncertain, but once she has a little time to settle in, she begins to show a much sillier side—play bows, soft puppy mouthing, and all.


Her first shelter playgroup followed that same pattern. Banana Cream initially sat quietly with her tail tucked and was uncomfortable when dogs approached too quickly. As the session went on, she relaxed, began throwing play bows, and eventually joined fellow shelter pups Polly Pocket and Dakota for chase play. She was comfortable enough afterward to be paired with a doggy roommate.


Banana Cream is looking for people who understand that confidence doesn’t always appear instantly. She does best when she isn’t rushed and is allowed to investigate at her own pace. Once she decides she feels safe, she can be playful, engaging, and downright goofy.


She has potential to live with a well-matched dog, particularly one who won’t overwhelm her with an intense greeting. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs.


For an adopter who enjoys watching a shy dog blossom into herself, Banana Cream could be an incredibly rewarding companion. Come meet her today!

name: Sabo
description_html:
With a large grin to match his large frame Sabo is ready to welcome everyone into his space. He adores people, adores friendly dogs, and adores children he has met along the path of life.

Sabo appreciates being part of the indoors family which is why shelter living is a shocker for this sweet guy. He's very house trained. He's stayed home alone for 4-8 hour stretches at a time, on his own with no troubles. He becomes his younger self when squishy toys are near, they're his favorite. He loves grooming and occasional water play.

He is RTG - Ready to Go - he's neutered, vaccinated, heart worm negative and ready to leave right away. See his short video here

Don't delay when a shelter dog is waiting for a helping hand out of the shelter.

name: Princess Donut
description_html:
Princess Donut is a playful little kitten looking for her forever home. She LOVES to stalk, chase, and wrestle and would do best with another kitten or young playful cat to play with. (Going with her sister Odette would be an added bonus since they already get along so well).

She has grown up in a foster home and needs to be an indoor only cat since she didn’t have a mom to teach her “street smarts.”

name: Odette
description_html:
This precious little kitten is looking for her forever family. She loves to play and cuddle up with her sister Princess Donut and would do best in a home with another kitten or young, active cat.

Odette has grown up in a foster home with only her sister and needs to be inside only cat since she doesn’t have the skills to protect herself outside.

name: Marty
description_html:
Meet Marty, a gentle, resilient soul. His people lost their housing and life was tough. They surrendered Marty so he could fine a happier, healthier life ahead. He's catching up on his weight and polishing his skin. He'll be as good as new to match the trusting, affectionate, kind soul he's always been with years of wisdom behind him.

Marty is housetrained, walks well on loose leash and loves to sniff and explore. He's a gentle friend who stays by your side for walks and doesn't mind stopping and talking to friends and passing other dogs. He also knows some basic cues. At home he's house trained and crate trained.

Time is precious for a dog waiting to recapture his life outside of the shelter walls. Don't delay when a shelter dog like Marty is spending another night sleeping in the shelter.

name: Dodge
description_html:
Dodge may be a big boy, but he’s the definition of a gentle giant. He is incredibly sweet, affectionate, and loves with his whole heart. His favorite place to be is wherever his people are, whether that’s lounging nearby, cuddling on the couch, or resting his head in your lap for pets.

He’s great with most people, gets along well with other dogs, and has been nothing but kind and gentle while in our home. He’s a laid-back boy who enjoys playing, but he’s just as happy spending most of the day relaxing by your side.

Dodge rarely barks. If he’s left alone, he may whine for a little while, but he settles himself down and relaxes. He can be a bit stubborn when it’s time to get off the bed, but it’s hard not to smile because he’s always so loving and gentle. He’s also an excellent car companion and rides like a pro and is potty trained!

If you’re looking for a loyal, affectionate dog with a calm, loving personality, Dodge is your guy.

name: Nilla
description_html: Nilla is what we lovingly call a "boss lady". She was found outside a restaurant, but there's no way this soft, round girl was trying to survive outdoors, so her history is a bit of a mystery! She enjoys pets in moderation and will let you know when she's had enough. Nilla is an independent girl with dreams and ambitions of her own, such as having a home to manage, windows to watch the neighbors, and a friend to share gossip. This boss is ready for her new job, so apply today to adopt this beauty!

name: Miss Daisy
description_html:
Hi, I’m Miss Daisy! 

I may be a little shy when we first meet, but once I get to know you and feel comfortable, I’ll show you just how sweet I am. I love spending quality time with my people — whether that means curling up beside you on the couch or settling into your lap for some cozy time together.


I also enjoy playing with other cats and would love having a feline companion. That said, I’m an independent girl and I’m perfectly happy entertaining myself when you’re busy.


I’m still learning about dogs, and they make me a little nervous, so I’d probably do best in a home without dogs. I haven’t been around children yet, so that’s something my foster family is still learning about me.


Right now, I’m taking daily medication to help me heal from a wound on my leg. 


If you’re looking for a gentle, sweet kitty who just needs a little time to come out of her shell, I might be your girl.

name: Jimmy
description_html: Jimmy is a friendly little guy who warms up to people quickly! He loves nose rubs and lap sitting with some fresh veggies (cilantro and parsley are his favorites). He doesn’t mind carefully supervised interaction with other pets and has done well around cats and dogs. He will make an easygoing companion for his forever home. Plus, he has the cutest white wig and big googly baby eyes!

name: Lasso
description_html:
Lasso came to the shelter very scared and unsure of people, but he’s already making steady progress.


He’s a quiet kitten who likes to take things at his own pace. He may hiss when his kennel door is opened, but it’s just fear—not aggression. With a Churu treat and a gentle approach, he quickly warms up and will accept soft pets.


Lasso is still building confidence, but he’s improving every day. In a calm, patient home, we know he will continue to blossom and learn that people can be kind and safe. He keeps getting overlooked, but he just needs someone willing to go slow and let trust grow one step at a time.

name: Grayson
description_html: Grayson is a sweet, slightly shy pup who quickly warms up and will be a wonderful addition to a home. He enjoys soft pets, chasing toys around the yard, and is very easy to walk on a leash. Come meet this cutie and see if he's the right fit for you!

name: Wednesday
description_html:
Meet Wednesday! 🖤

Wednesday may be a smaller dog, but she has a HUGE heart! At around 30 lbs, she's a wonderfully manageable size, and this sweet 2-year-old is happiest when she's with her people.

Wednesday is an absolute cuddlebug who loves pressing up against you on the couch and following her favorite people around the house. She bonded with her foster family incredibly quickly and gets the biggest smile and happiest tail wag when they come home. Despite being so excited to see people, she's also surprisingly quiet—we've only heard her bark a couple of times!

Wednesday is a sweet, eager-to-please dog who is ready to learn. She doesn't know many formal commands yet, but she's incredibly responsive to her people and quickly comes back when redirected. She's learning leash manners and that potty time happens outside, but her foster family has been impressed by how willing she is to listen and do the right thing. At home, she's relaxed, non-destructive, and happy to lounge with her people.

Wednesday has been doing well with her foster family's cat, mostly ignoring her but occasionally getting curious and wanting to play. She's easily redirected and leaves the cat alone when asked. She has also had a promising introduction to small dogs. As always, thoughtful introductions with new animals are recommended.

Wednesday loves getting outside and especially enjoys having the opportunity to safely run and explore, but she's also perfectly happy going on a short walk and curling up on the couch afterward. She's a great car rider, too—she jumps right in and settles down for the whole ride!

If you're looking for a sweet, affectionate companion who will greet you like you're the best person in the world, follow you around the house, and happily curl up beside you, Wednesday might be your girl. 🖤

name: Tomas
description_html:
Tomas came to us from a home with far too many cats—we’ve taken in over 50 from that location alone. He’s one of the lucky ones getting a fresh start.


From day one, it was clear Tomas loves other cats… maybe a little too much! 😘This affectionate boy recently had his neuter surgery, and now that his hormones are settling, his sweet personality is starting to shine through. He loves to curl up on his bed looking adorable!


Tomas is friendly, social, and ready to leave the past behind. Can you be the home to give him a second chance? Meet Tomas today!

name: Prissy
description_html:
A lovely & loving lady, so easy & gentle to be with. She adores people-they make her heart sing!


Prissy is RTG - READY TO GO -she's spayed, vaccinated, heart worm negative and knows a whole lot about good home living. She lived with a family for the last 4 years practicing all her good girl skills, staying home alone, house and crate trained, for 4-8 hrs. She's lived with a male dog friend. And she lived with a child. She's not as sure about cats but reserves the right to change her mind after studying them from a safe distance for awhile.


Her owner said: she loves soft beds and loves to relax. She loves watching squirrels and loves kids.

Prissy has the advocacy of her friends at Classic Canines who give extra support for the mature dogs. This lady is ready to slide into a loving stable home that will suit her for years to come. Inquire on her link to connect with her foster.

name: Misty (petco)
description_html:
Misty is available for adoption at Petco in Oak Hill! Go there to meet her.


Misty may have a soft name, but she’s a true little fighter. 💪


She was very sick with a severe upper respiratory infection that caused dehydration, weight loss, and an eye infection. She required intensive care, including medication, nebulizer treatments, and twice-daily fluids from our veterinary team.


But Misty never gave up—and neither did we. Day by day, she grew stronger, and her playful, loving personality returned. Today, she’s healthy, happy, and ready for a forever home. Misty has overcome so much in her short life. Now she just needs someone to give this brave little survivor the loving home she deserves.

name: Darcy
description_html:
Darcy arrived as a stray, but it was clear right away she’s a friendly, affectionate girl who likely once had a family. While at the shelter, she developed an upper respiratory infection and handled treatment like a champ. She’s now fully recovered and ready for a fresh start.


Darcy is incredibly affectionate and absolutely loves being around people. She’s playful, energetic, and full of personality, always ready for fun or a cuddle. She’s also very food-motivated—canned food is the way to her heart! 🍽️


Darcy would thrive in a home where she’ll get plenty of love, attention, and interaction. She has so much affection to give and would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a sweet, adorable cat to share life with.


Darcy deserves a soft bed, a full bowl, and a loving home where she’ll never have to fend for herself again. Could Darcy be your new best friend? ❤️🐾

name: Junie
description_html:
🐾 Meet Junie: 2yrs old, 10/10 personality. 💕


Yes, you saw that right... this girl is missing a paw! But please don’t tell Junie she’s supposed to be slowed down by it, because she clearly did not get that memo. 😂

Junie was born without one of her paws, and while she may prefer a nice grassy stroll over pounding the pavement, three paws are plenty for sniffing adventures, couch climbing, snack acquisition, and stealing hearts.


This calm, gentle house hippo is an absolute sweetheart. She’s a lovely loose-leash walker who likes to take her time, smell the smells, and enjoy the journey. And if treats happen to be involved? Even better. Junie is VERY snack motivated and would like everyone to know that compensation for being adorable is expected.


After spending more than two weeks in a crate at the shelter, Junie has settled beautifully into her kennel routine. She’s housetrained, leash-trained, cuddly, and perfectly happy to trade adventures for some quality couch time with her people.

She’s also interested in other dogs and has a playful side when the mood strikes. But overall? Junie’s vibe is less marathon athlete and more “Where are we going, and will there be snacks and a couch when we get there?”


She is thriving with her foster in an apartment with an elevator and would do great in a home with a backyard! She is so sweet to the resident dog, her 7-year-old foster auntie, Arya.


Junie, isn’t looking for sympathy. She’s looking for a home. Preferably a comfortable one, with a human attached who appreciates a laid-back, affectionate, slightly wonky house hippo. 🥹


✨ 3 paws

✨ 5-star snuggler

✨ Housetrained

✨ Leash-trained

✨ Crate comfortable

✨ Dog Social

✨ Professional couch potato

✨ Certified snack enthusiast


Junie may be missing a paw, but she isn’t missing a thing that matters. 💗

Now she just needs her person.

name: Bandido
description_html:
Bandido is a fun-loving, affectionate guy with plenty of personality! He’s got lots of energy when he first gets out of his kennel and may be jumpy or a little mouthy, but he gets his “ya-yas” out quickly and settles down beautifully. Once he’s had some exercise and playtime, Bandido is happy to slow down and ask for kisses and belly rubs.


Bandido is playful, curious, and very interested in people. He enjoys sniffing and exploring and gives his handler lots of check-ins. He can be easily distracted and is reactive to other dogs, with some barking and lunging, but he’s been easy to redirect. He’s also a strong leash puller and would do best with a harness rather than a slip leash or collar.


Although his previous family reported that he wasn’t housetrained, Bandido has consistently kept his kennel dry and urgently goes potty outdoors as soon as he gets outside, suggesting he may have good outdoor potty habits. He’s an active, playful companion who will thrive with regular exercise, enrichment, and someone who appreciates a silly, affectionate dog with a big personality.

name: Mercy
description_html:
Mercy is a sweet, affectionate young dog with a huge zest for life. She loves people, loves being petted, and has been described by shelter staff as friendly with everyone she meets. She also walks beautifully on leash, making her a great candidate for an active family who wants a companion for daily adventures. 

Mercy is also very social with other dogs. When she first entered shelter playgroup, she greeted with happy tail wags and play bows and jumped right into fun, puppyish play. She’ll likely do great in a home with a well-matched canine companion—ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dog(s)!

At heart, Mercy is a friendly, playful, people-loving girl who is ready for a chance to decompress outside the shelter and show off her best self. If you’re looking for an affectionate, joyful companion with plenty of personality, come meet Mercy.

name: Eva
description_html:
Eva is a young dog that is understandably nervous of the loud shelter environment. Go slow and at her pace, and she will warm up with tail wags and playful zooms. She enjoys sniffing and exploring.


Eva is a sweet girl that is shy and she just crave chest scratches then it all changed. She'll happily seat there for hours when the scratches get going.
